DIGITAL FORENSICS EXAMINATION REPORT Examiner: Dr. Nathan Cross, Lead Digital Forensics Specialist Case: Meridian Tech Server Room B Breach
Date of Analysis: October 13, 2024 1. PHYSICAL SECURITY FINDINGS

Physical inspection revealed the door latch pin was taped down with electrical tape, leaving the room open and accessible without authorization. The magnetic lock failed to engage because of the black vinyl electrical tape covering the sensor contact. 2.

HARDWARE & CONSOLE INSPECTION Console 2 in Server Room B was examined for digital traces:
- At 22:18:12, an active administrative session under username 'avance_admin' was used to query the customer database.
- At 22:20:45, a mass storage USB device was physically inserted into front USB port 1. Device identity: Kingston DataTraveler 3.0 (Serial: KTX-9941-B).
- At 22:31:18, an unencrypted archive 'customer_vault_export.tar.gz' (4.2 GB) was written directly to the USB drive.
- No outbound external network connection was established; the data was copied locally to a high-speed Kingston USB 3.0 flash drive directly mounted at Console 2.
- The USB drive was unmounted cleanly at 22:37:55.
3. LATENT EVIDENCE Latent fingerprints lifted from Console 2 keyboard and the electrical tape roll match contractor David Wright.

chunks.speaker: INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT
chunks.text: INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT: ALICE VANCE Case: Meridian Tech Data Leak Date: October 13, 2024

chunks.speaker: Alice Vance
chunks.text: Interviewer: Detective Marcus Reed, Corporate Security Interviewee: Alice Vance, Lead Software Engineer [09:30 AM] REED: State your name and position for the record.

chunks.speaker: Alice Vance
chunks.text: [09:30 AM] VANCE: Alice Vance, Lead Software Engineer at Meridian Tech. I've been with the company for four years. [09:31 AM] REED: Alice, where were you on the night of October 12, 2024, between 9:00 PM and midnight? [09:31 AM] VANCE: I was at my desk on Floor 3 the entire night from 9:30 PM until midnight, working on the quarterly release notes. I did not leave Floor 3 once during that window.

chunks.speaker: Alice Vance
chunks.text: [09:32 AM] REED: Did you enter Server Room B at any point yesterday evening? [09:32 AM] VANCE: Absolutely not. I did not enter Server Room B yesterday. I haven't been in the basement server vault for at least two weeks. My badge shouldn't even show any activity down there. [09:33 AM] REED: Did you notice anyone unusual on Floor 3?

chunks.speaker: Alice Vance
chunks.text: [09:33 AM] VANCE: I saw Bob Chen around 9:15 PM in the hallway, and David Wright, the electrical maintenance contractor, was working on the conduit near the breakroom around 9:40 PM. [09:34 AM] REED: Did you download or transfer any files from the customer database? [09:34 AM] VANCE: No. All database exports require two-factor authentication, and I never initiated any data transfer.

chunks.speaker: Alice Vance
chunks.text: [09:35 AM] REED: Thank you, Alice. That is all for now.

chunks.speaker: INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT
chunks.text: INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT: BOB CHEN Case: Meridian Tech Data Leak Date: October 13, 2024

chunks.speaker: Bob Chen
chunks.text: Interviewer: Detective Marcus Reed, Corporate Security Interviewee: Bob Chen, IT Systems Administrator [10:15 AM] REED: Please state your name and role.

chunks.speaker: Bob Chen
chunks.text: [10:15 AM] CHEN: Bob Chen, IT Systems Administrator for Meridian Tech. [10:16 AM] REED: Can you walk us through your whereabouts on the evening of October 12? [10:16 AM] CHEN: I arrived at Building 4 at 8:00 PM for scheduled server maintenance. Around 9:30 PM, I stepped out to pick up takeout from the deli down the street. I came back around 10:20 PM and worked at my terminal until 1:00 AM.

chunks.speaker: Bob Chen
chunks.text: [10:17 AM] REED: Where was your master keycard during that time? [10:17 AM] CHEN: I had my physical master keycard in my wallet all evening and never lent it to anyone. I keep it chained to my belt loop at all times. [10:18 AM] REED: Did you enter Server Room B during the night?

chunks.speaker: Bob Chen
chunks.text: [10:18 AM] CHEN: No, I worked strictly from my office on Floor 2. I had no reason to visit Server Room B because my remote SSH console was functioning properly. [10:19 AM] REED: Did you authorize any subcontractor or outside technician to access the server vault? [10:19 AM] CHEN: No, absolutely not. Subcontractors are strictly prohibited from entering secure zones without an escort.

chunks.speaker: Bob Chen
chunks.text: [10:20 AM] REED: Thank you, Bob.

chunks.speaker: David Wright
chunks.text: Interviewer: Detective Marcus Reed, Corporate Security Interviewee: David Wright, Subcontractor / Maintenance Technician [11:00 AM] REED: State your name and affiliation.

chunks.speaker: David Wright
chunks.text: [11:00 AM] WRIGHT: David Wright. I am an independent electrical contractor working on assignment for Apex Solutions at Meridian Tech. [11:01 AM] REED: What was your assignment on the night of October 12? [11:01 AM] WRIGHT: I was contracted to test circuit breakers and emergency lighting on Floor 3 and in the basement utility hallway.

chunks.speaker: David Wright
chunks.text: [11:02 AM] REED: What time did you arrive and leave Building 4? [11:02 AM] WRIGHT: I got there around 8:30 PM. I finished my electrical maintenance and left Building 4 at 10:00 PM sharp. I drove straight home. [11:03 AM] REED: Did you enter Server Room B?

chunks.speaker: David Wright
chunks.text: [11:03 AM] WRIGHT: No way. The door to Server Room B was locked and marked restricted. I didn't have the badge access for it anyway. [11:04 AM] REED: Did you see Bob Chen or Alice Vance during your shift? [11:04 AM] WRIGHT: I saw Alice at her computer on Floor 3 around 9:40 PM. And I saw Bob leave his lanyard and keycard on the breakroom table around 9:45 PM when he went down to get takeout. It was sitting right there next to the coffee machine.

chunks.speaker: David Wright
chunks.text: [11:05 AM] REED: Did you touch Bob's lanyard or keycard? [11:05 AM] WRIGHT: No, I didn't touch it. I just noticed it sitting on the table. [11:06 AM] REED: Understood. Thank you, Mr. Wright.

chunks.speaker: INCIDENT REPORT
chunks.text: INCIDENT REPORT: CRITICAL DATA BREACH Case ID: MER-2024-881 Date: October 13, 2024

chunks.speaker: Elena Rostova
chunks.text: Author: Elena Rostova, Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Classification: CONFIDENTIAL // INTERNAL INVESTIGATION 1.

chunks.speaker: Elena Rostova
chunks.text: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY At approximately 03:15 AM on October 13, 2024, Meridian Tech automated intrusion alarms alerted security operations to an unauthorized bulk database export from the core customer relational database in Server Room B. Approximately 450,000 sensitive customer identity and billing records were extracted.

chunks.speaker: Elena Rostova
chunks.text:
2. TIMELINE OF INCIDENT
- 2024-10-12 21:00:00 - Routine shift handover in Building 4.
- 2024-10-12 22:14:30 - Physical entry recorded at Server Room B.
- 2024-10-12 22:18:00 - Database administrative session initiated on Console 2.
- 2024-10-12 22:31:00 - Data extraction command executed.
- 2024-10-12 22:38:00 - Session terminated; console logged off. 3.

chunks.speaker: Elena Rostova
chunks.text: PHYSICAL ACCESS OBSERVATIONS Facilities Maintenance initial report stated the magnetic door lock on Server Room B was fully engaged and secured during the 10:00 PM security patrol. However, physical evidence recovered on October 13 indicates security mechanisms were tampered with prior to the intrusion.

chunks.speaker: Elena Rostova
chunks.text: 4. PRELIMINARY IMPACT Customer privacy records compromise poses extreme legal and reputational liability.

chunks.speaker: Elena Rostova
chunks.text: Immediate isolation of Building 4 server infrastructure was ordered by CISO Elena Rostova.
